questions.q: How many Profiles can a single Salesforce user have, per this lesson?
options: Any number, stacked together like Permission Sets
Exactly two, one for records and one for fields
Exactly one -- it's mandatory and not additive with other profiles
Zero or one, at the user's discretion
questions.explain: A Profile is the mandatory baseline; every user has exactly one, unlike Permission Sets.

questions.q: How many Permission Sets can a single user be assigned, per this lesson?
options: Exactly two, no more and no fewer
Any number -- zero, one, or several stacked together
Exactly one, same as a Profile
None -- Permission Sets are assigned to Profiles, not users
questions.explain: Permission Sets are additive and stackable -- a user can have any number assigned.

questions.q: Can a Permission Set take away a permission that a user's Profile already grants them?
options: Yes, but only for field-level security, never object-level
No -- Permission Sets are additive only, they never remove access
Yes, Permission Sets can both add and remove permissions freely
It depends on which Profile the user has
questions.explain: The lesson states explicitly that Permission Sets never take permissions away, only add them.

questions.q: Per this lesson, what is a user's real, effective access made up of?
options: Only their Profile -- Permission Sets don't actually affect real access
Only whichever single Permission Set was assigned most recently
Their Profile's permissions plus every assigned Permission Set, unioned together
Whichever grants fewer permissions, Profile or Permission Set
questions.explain: Effective access is the union of the Profile's baseline plus everything every assigned Permission Set adds.

questions.q: Why does this lesson recommend using a Permission Set rather than building a whole new Profile for a handful of users needing one extra piece of access?
options: Profiles can only ever be assigned to exactly one user total
Permission Sets are required by Salesforce for any access change of any kind
New Profiles are technically impossible to create in Salesforce
Permission Sets handle exceptions without exploding the number of near-duplicate profiles an org has to maintain
questions.explain: The lesson frames Permission Sets as the right tool precisely because they avoid unnecessary profile proliferation.
